page_text:
LAW OFFICES OF PHIL LYNCH 
17503 LA CANTERA PARKWAY 
SUITE 104-623 
SAN ANTONIO, TX 78257 
(210-883-4435) 

June 30, 2019 

Mr. Scott Harris 
Clerk, Supreme Court 
 of the United States 
1 First Street, NE 
Washington, D.C. 20543 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

Re: Gonzalo Holguin-Hernandez  
   v. United States of America, 18-7739 

I  am  counsel  of  record  in  this  case.  My  co-counsel,  Jeffrey  Fisher,  and  I  have 
conferred with Morgan  Ratner,  counsel for  respondent,  and  Winn  Allen,  invited amicus 
counsel. After those conferences, and with an understanding that the case is likely to be set 
for argument in November 2019, we ask for an extension of time and suggest the following 
filing schedule: the separate briefs of Petitioner and Respondent would be filed on July 29, 
2019, the Joint Appendix would be filed on July 29, 2019, and the brief of invited amicus 
counsel  would  be  filed  on  September  9,  2019.  All  counsel  agree  with  this  suggested 
schedule and the schedule would allow for the reply brief to be filed well in advance of the 
likely argument date.  

Very truly yours, 

/s/ Philip J. Lynch 
Philip J. Lynch 

cc: Morgan Ratner 
     Winn Allen 
     Jeffrey Fisher
